bio.text: Ben Albritton represents District 27 in the Florida Senate, to which Albritton was first elected in 2018, and served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018.
In the Senate, Albritton was Majority Leader from 2022 to 2024.
The Senate lists Albritton's occupation as agribusiness owner. Albritton holds a B.S. in business and citrus from Florida Southern College (1990) and was born in Lakeland, Florida.
